title: Providing default themes for react-instantsearch widgets
body:
react-instantsearch currently use under the hood react-themable for styling widgets. Using this library allow a user to style its components using its preferred approach (ex: pure css, css-modules or aphrodite...)

By default, react-instantsearch is only providing BEM classes to components.

Issue : it would be nice to have some default themes, especially for the components that are a bit hard to style. However, default themes must not be intrusive for the user.

As discussed, we will provide default themes using Aphrodite, but the user will have to explicitly import it and use it through the props `theme` that already exists.

ToDo:

* Checking that creating Aphrodite Stylesheet without using it, doesn't have some side-effects.
* Create default theme for each widgets.
